name: Diósberény (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Diósberény (a green shield with a white walnut tree and a wavy stripe, within a green wreath) below a scroll inscribed DIÓSBERÉNY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Diósberény arms with wreath and scroll
